title: Fix MSGraphSensor timeout being reset on every re-defer
decision: Stop passing the sensor timeout to MSGraphTrigger and keep the HTTP timeout at the trigger/hook default None
why: timeout=self.timeout became the httpx per-request timeout (7 days by default), while each request is still bounded by the remaining sensor time
quote: A dedicated HTTP-timeout parameter can follow if needed.
rejected_alternative: Add a dedicated HTTP-timeout parameter now
